latestVersion.changelog:
Video Cartoon Maker Free — First public release.

- Instantly convert uploaded videos or images into cartoon-animated style with bold outlines and flat colors.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB); runs cloud-based, no local install needed.
- Simple, guided workflow: upload → describe effect → receive 1080p MP4 in 1-2 minutes.
- Includes credits system, export/download, session management, and error handling.
- Common use cases and prompt examples provided for content creators and social users.
